output_list.criticism: The 'mint' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to arbitrary value. This can lead to unexpected token distribution.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow in these two lines: 'require(_value <= balances[msg.sender] ); balances[_to] += _value;'. This can lead to unexpected token distribution.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow in these two lines: 'require(_value <= balances[from] ); allowed[from][msg.sender] -= _value; balances[to] += _value;'. This can lead to unexpected token distribution.
The 'PreSaleStarted' function does not check any condition, allowing any user to start the pre-sale, aka 'Early Sale'.
